info.description:
Note that all date parameters are ISO8601, e.g. `2004-02-12T15:00:00+10:00`. If `modifiedBefore`/`modifiedAfter` and/or `createdBefore`/`createdAfter` combinations are used, the results will reflect the data range in between these.

For all filters accepting multiple comma-separated values, the API also supports the RFC 3986 format:
* /api/endpoint?include=a,b,c (Comma-separated values format)
* /api/endpoint?include[]=a&include[]=b&include[]=c (RFC 3986 format)


Response schemas in this document are derived from observed API responses (see scripts/capture-samples.ts), not from the vendor document, whose response definitions are largely unusable. Every scalar is typed `string` because that is what the API sends.

post.description:
Allows to create a contacts.

Data in the following editable fields will be saved on created contacts:
- `title`
- `firstName`
- `lastName`
- `type`: Must be either "Person" or "Business"
- `customSalutation` (if supplied, will override the system generated `salutation`)
- `companyName`
- `jobTitle`
- `email`
- `mobile`
- `homePhone`
- `workPhone`
- `streetAddress`
- `source`: Must be one of the values from GET /contact-sources
- `comments`
- `attachedRelatedStaffMembers`:
  - role: Must be either "Primary Owner", "View Only", or "Full Access"
  - id: Staff Member ID
- `contactClasses`: Must be valid values from GET /contact-classes
- `subscriptions`: Must be valid values from GET /subscription

parameters.description: Unique Contact Id

put.description:
Allows to update a contact.
It can be used to update contact's editable fields,
or to subscribe/unsubscribe contacts from specific newsletters.

The `salutation` field will output a system generated value by default. To override it, set the expected value in the `customSalutation` field.

Editable fields include:
- `title`
- `firstName`
- `lastName`
- `type`: Must be either "Person" or "Business"
- `status`: Must be either "Active", "Archived", "Do Not Contact" or "Unsubscribed"
- `customSalutation` (if supplied, will override the system generated `salutation`)
- `companyName`
- `jobTitle`
- `email`
- `mobile`
- `homePhone`
- `workPhone`
- `streetAddress`
- `source`: Must be one of the values from GET /contact-sources
- `comments`
- `attachedRelatedStaffMembers`:
  - role: Must be either "Primary Owner", "View Only", or "Full Access"
  - id: Staff Member ID
- `contactClasses`: Must be valid values from GET /contact-classes
- `subscriptions`: Must be valid values from GET /subscription

The following flags are used to toggle the behaviour of the corresponding fields to whether append new values or overwrite exisitng values:
- `attachedRelatedStaffAppendable`: When it is set to `false` or it is not provided, existing `attachedRelatedStaffMembers` will be overwritten.
  When it is set to `true`, new `attachedRelatedStaffMembers` will be appended.
- `contactClassesAppendable`: When it is set to `false` or it is not set, existing `contactClasses` will be overwritten.
  When it is set to `true, new `contactClasses` will be appended.
- `subscriptionsAppendable`: When it is set to `false` or it is not set, existing `subscriptions` will be overwritten.
  When it is set to `true, new `subscriptions` will be appended.

post.description:
Allows for creation of a enquiry.
It can be used to post a general enquiry, or a listing/project enquiry.

*The following data is needed to create a general enquiry:*
- `attachedContact`: An contact object. See `/POST contacts`.
  - If `id` is not provided within the contact data, the system will first try to match an existing contact based on the given email or mobile.
    If no match is found, a new contact will be created. If an existing contact is matched, it will be attached to the enquiry and it will not be overwritten.
    To update an existing contact please use `PUT /contacts` endpoint.
  - The below flags are options under the `attachedContact`->`actions` object
    - `attachListingAgents`: When set to true, listing agent(s) will be attached to the contact.
    - `addDefaultContactClasses`: When set to true, system default contact classes for the enquiry type will be attached to the contact.
    - `addDefaultSubscriptions`: When set to true, system default subscriptions for the enquiry type will be attached to the contact.
    - `addDefaultRequirements`: When set to true, system default requirements for the enquiry type will be attached to the contact.

- `comment`: Enquiry content

*To create a listing/project enquiry, one of the following data is needed in addition to the above mandatory data:*
- `attachedListing`: An object containing listing Id.
- `attachedProject`: An object containing project Id.


The following data is optional:
- `date`: ISO 8601 date. Current datetime will be used if not provided. Default timezone will be used if timezone is not specified.
- `type`: Must be one of the values from `GET /enquiry-types`
- `source`: Must be one of the values from `GET /enquiry-sources`
- `prospectiveBuyerDetails`: (for listing/project enquiry)
  - `contractTaken`: Boolean
  - `reportTaken`: Boolean
  - `ongoingInterest`: Boolean
  - `followUp`: Boolean
  - `priceFeedback`: Integer
  - `interestLevel`: Must be one of the values from `GET /enquiry-interest-levels`

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description:
Order results by soldPrice, searchPrice, address, lastModified, firstCreated, listedDate, nextInspectionDate. When nextInspectionDate order is selected, either inspectionStartDate or inspectionEndDate filter must be applied. The next inspection date inside of the filtered results will be used in the ordering.  
You can also order by multiple columns by passing the `orderBy` parameter as an array, whereby the key is the column you wish to order by and the value is the order direction.  
**For example:**  
orderBy[status]=ASC&  
orderBy[lastModified]=DESC
**Note** if you use this format, you no longer need to use the `order` parameter.

put.description:
Allows for the management of a contacts subscription/newsletter preferences.
Can be used to globally unsubscribe a contact from all email communication,
or to selectively subscribe/unsubscribe/remove contacts from specific newsletters.

If the action is passed in as `unsubscribe` but no `subscriptions` parameter
is supplied, this will be treated as a *global* unsubscribe which will
change the contact status in the CRM to *Unsubscribed* (thus preventing
any email newsletters being sent to this contact, regardless of other
subscription preferences).

get.description:
Returns a list of newsletter subscriptions which can be used to pass into
the "subscribe" endpoint to subscribe or unsubscribe contacts from specific
mailing lists.
